title: Basic First Aid
description: Starts with scene safety and the ABC primary assessment, then walks through unconsciousness, shock, choking, diabetic emergencies, seizures, and anaphylaxis. Covers wound cleaning and improvised bandages, drug-free pain relief, kit essentials, and what to do when professional help can't come.
shortDescription: Scene safety, ABCs, shock, choking, seizures, and wound care without power
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
